Pumpkin-seed coach with a carved pinecone-roof lantern, oak-gall wheels, gold-thread trim, waiting at a stone-step in a cottage garden.
Pinecone-rolling cart with layered-scale sides, twig-handle, carrying a load of dried lavender buds along a sandy herb-garden border.
Berry-cart with acorn-cap wheels, twig-spoke rims, a mound of blueberries, parked in dappled shade beneath a broad fern-frond.
Twig-and-bark velocipede with birchbark wheels, pine-needle spokes, propped against a mushroom at the edge of a sunlit forest path.
Mouse-drawn diligence — birchbark coach, twig-lanterns, oak-gall wheels, silk-thread reins, a rosy field-mouse pulling it past a thimble milestone.
Eggshell coracle with a silk-thread-sewn twig-frame and a reed-bundle seat, bobbing in a garden watering-can among floating rose petals.
Pinecone-scale paddleboat with a fern-frond stern-paddle and pine-resin-sealed hull, carrying a ladybug passenger across a glass bowl of water.
Amanita-cap submarine — red-and-white spotted hull, acorn-cap hatch, brass-bead periscope — resting on smooth river-pebbles beside a woodland stream.
Milkweed-pod canoe — split-pod hull, silk-thread-lashed twig-ribs, milkweed-fluff cushion seat — drifting on an autumn puddle among fallen maple-leaves.
